plainTranslation:
This person can get under your skin without meaning to. It may be something small: the way they jump in with an opinion, the confidence they bring into a room, or the way they seem completely comfortable doing things their own way. Whatever it is, you may find yourself reacting more strongly than the situation seems to call for.

When this works, it can push you to be more honest with yourself. This person may have a way of exposing habits, blind spots, or assumptions you usually do not question. You may not always enjoy being challenged by them, but they can make it harder to keep doing things the same way without noticing why.

The harder part is when everything starts feeling personal. You may read their confidence as arrogance. They may read yours the same way. A normal difference in style can start to feel like disrespect, even when neither person means it that way.

Not every difference is a challenge to answer. Sometimes the other person is just being themselves, not trying to outshine you. The more you can remember that, the easier it is to stop turning friction into a competition.
